reasoning: SNS5（outline 10.5）在 037 同時存在 parent 066 與 sub-id 066-01 / 066-02,三者皆標為 Functional Requirement。依 A-H01 裁決,066 的內容已完全分解為 -01（啟動路徑）與 -02（通知回饋）,自身無殘餘內容,故不產獨立 TC——寫一條只會與兩個子項重複追溯（§8.2.1）;但 037 既標為 Functional Requirement,完整性不變量仍要求一列,故出 placeholder。066-02 的通知本體在 PDF p.16 被明確畫為灰底佔位框「See Navigation Supplier Release for Details」,表示通知的外觀與文字由 Navigation 供應商規格持有（§8.4.2）。因此 066-02 的 ER 只主張 Home 側可觀察的事實：路徑啟動後出現了路徑已開始的通知,不主張其版面、文字或停留時間。066-01 與 066-02 的差異軸為「動作結果」與「回饋」,兩者同一次按壓觸發,但 037 已拆 sub-id,§8.2.1 勝出。優先級:啟動路徑是 navigation shortcut 存在的理由,066-01 訂 P0;通知屬回饋,訂 P2。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 066 fully delegated (placeholder); -01 the route starts; -02 the notification is provided

coverage_notes: The notification's appearance and wording are rendered in PDF p.16 as 'See Navigation Supplier Release for Details' — supplier-owned (§8.4.2). Only its presence is asserted.

tcs.test_item:
Once a shortcut is set, pressing it shall start the route.

(Navigation shortcut pressed with no route active -> a route to the shortcut's location is started)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. A Shortcuts widget is placed on a Home Screen page
3. A navigation shortcut to a saved location is set in the Shortcuts widget
4. No route is active
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that contains the Shortcuts widget
2. Select the navigation shortcut
3. Read the route state in the Navigation application
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the Shortcuts widget is displayed
2. A route is started
3. The active route destination is the location set in the navigation shortcut
tcs.specification_reference: Home Screen HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 Post 2A (March 17 2023)_10.5
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall implement Route Started Notification Feedback: Provide a notification that a route has begun.

(Navigation shortcut pressed with no route active -> a notification stating the route has begun is displayed)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. A Shortcuts widget is placed on a Home Screen page
3. A navigation shortcut to a saved location is set in the Shortcuts widget
4. No route is active
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that contains the Shortcuts widget
2. Select the navigation shortcut
3. Read the notification displayed on the screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the Shortcuts widget is displayed
2. A route to the location set in the navigation shortcut is started
3. A notification stating that the route has begun is displayed
tcs.specification_reference: Home Screen HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 Post 2A (March 17 2023)_10.5
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: Notification layout and wording are supplier-owned (PDF p.16 placeholder); only its presence is asserted
